# Lex Aureon

> Constitutional AI governance layer for LLMs and agents. It models output as a point on a simplex (Continuity, Reciprocity, Sovereignty), enforces a stability margin with a control barrier function, and writes a signed audit receipt for every governed turn.

## Key links

- [Live system](https://www.lexaureon.com): product and demo
- [Repository](https://github.com/omomehinemmanuel5-boop/LEX-Aureon): source code and README
- [Paper](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20183807): theory and framework
- [Benchmarks](https://www.lexaureon.com/benchmarks): bare vs. governed results
- [Public audit trail](https://www.lexaureon.com/audit)
- [Research](https://www.lexaureon.com/research)
